newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - NAB says St George stake strategic.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - NAB says St George stake strategic.

text.p: MELBOURNE, Jan 23 (Retuer) - National Australia Bank said on Thursday that its stake in the newly merged St George Bank Ltd group remained a strategic one, but declined to comment further.
"It's a strategic holding. We have made our decision to hold the stock," NAB managing director Don Argus told reporters after the bank's annual meeting.
He said it was irrelevant to talk about any unrealised gain on the investment because it did not intend to trade its stake.
"You only mark to market if you are going to trade the stock," Argus said.
St George Bank and Advance Bank Australia earlier this month completed an agreed merger.
National Australia Bank had a three percent stake in Advance and 6.8 percent of St George before the merger, and had been widely seen as being interested in buying regional banks.
